violation_type.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers- Operation Telephone Number, Name, and Address (26 TAC §744.405(a)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers- Operation Telephone Number, Name, and Address
violation_type.typical_finding: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being recited.  The name, telephone number and address of the operation are not on the list of required telephone numbers.
